# Registry of public types in MetBench_BLL.Core that have >= 2 projection paths.
# Per CLAUDE.md §12.4 R1, adding a field to any of these types REQUIRES touching
# the corresponding ParityTests file in the same PR. The G10 governance grep
# check in dotnet-test.yml enforces this.
#
# Format: <TypeName>=<ParityTestsFile1>[,<ParityTestsFile2>,...]
# - Use comma-separated paths when multiple parity test files cover the type.
# - Use the literal token NONE when no parity test exists yet (G10 emits a
#   stronger warning pointing at the registered gap).
# - Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Phase 4 Roslyn analyzer (METBENCH001) is planned to supersede this list
# with AST-based detection. While that ships, this list is the source of
# truth and must be updated whenever a new multi-projection type appears.

# Catalog ↔ Manifest projection (HardcodedMrCatalogProvider + ManifestMrCatalogProvider)
MrCatalogEntry=MetBench_SystemMT.Tests/SystemMT/Catalog/CatalogParityTests.cs

# Launcher summary list (consumed by ListAvailableAsync + LauncherCatalogV2Importer)
MrSummary=NONE

# Result record (rendered by 5 renderers: HTML / Markdown / PDF / Word / Excel)
SystemMtResultRecord=NONE

# Execution evidence (recorder write + HTML/Markdown/PDF/Word/Excel rendering)
ExecutionEvidence=NONE
